main.description: The person a request went to accepts it; the caller, its recipient, becomes the sender's contact. Only the DID the request went to finds it, and a repeated acceptance hears the same answer.

name.description: The accepting person's name, as the sender will see it. At most 256 UTF-16 code units.

generation.description: The connection; each delivery names it.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: This Ship sent the caller no message request with this ID.

errors.name: Gone
errors.description: The message request expired or was withdrawn, declined or blocked, or the connection its acceptance made has been replaced or removed.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: A newer connection between these people is already active, or the request's conversation changed while it was being accepted.
